title: BEAMS INDUSTRIES, INC.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELTS:LAP:FRONT (1,479 affected)
summary: APPROXIMATELY 10" TO 11" OF EXCESS WEBBING CAN CAUSE THE FIRST POINT OF LOCK-UP TO BE DELAYED. THIS DOES NOT CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO.209, "SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES."

title: Oshkosh Corporation: BRAKES:AIR DRYER (33 affected)
summary: AIR SYSTEM BLOCKAGE IN THE AIR DRYER OCCURS DEGRADING THE MOISTURE REMOVING CAPABILITIES OF THE DRYER WHEN THE VEHICLE IS OPERATED IN A COLD ENVIRONMENT AND MOISTURE ACCUMULATES AND FREEZES IN THE AIR DRYER OR IN THE LINE BETWEEN THE DRYER AND THE AIR SYSTEM RESERVOIR. THE AIR DRYER CAN BECOME OVERPRESSURIZED CAUSING THE AIR DRYER CARTRIDGE TO SEPARATE FROM THE MOUNTING BASE.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (29,000 affected)
summary: THE HAND THROTTLE CABLE CAN WEAR THE BRASS SWIVEL BLOCK ON THE GOVERNOR LEVER THROUGH WHICH IT PASSES.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (278 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES WERE BUILT WITH AN IMPROPERLY PLUMBED BRAKE SYSTEM WHICH AFFECTS THE BRAKING ON THE REAR AXLE WHEN RUNNING EITHER BOBTAIL OR PULLING A TRAILER.

title: UNION CITY BODY COMPANY LLC: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL (43 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES WERE BUILT WITH INCORRECT TIRE, WHEEL, AND INFLATION INFORMATION PRINTED ON THE FINAL STAGE MANUFACTURER'S CERTIFICATION LABEL. THIS DOES NOT MEET THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 120, "TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS FOR MOTOR VHEICLES OTHER THAN PASSENGER CARS."

title: American Cargo Group Trailers, LLC: EQUIPMENT:LIFT:WRECKER (137 affected)
summary: INSUFFICIENT GROUNDING OF THE ELECTRICAL PUMP ASSEMBLY.

title: Shyft Group: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT ATTACHING MECHANISMS: (161 affected)
summary: THE REAR SPRING HANGER ON THE FRONT SUSPENSION CAN BREAK.

title: Ducati North America: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL/MOTORCYCLE (1,000 affected)
summary: THE TEFLON BUSHING FOR THE THROTTLE CABLE CAN SLIDE OUT OF THE THROTTLE CABLE HOUSING.

title: General Motors, LLC: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:HEAD LIGHTS (12,832 affected)
summary: THE DRIVER SIDE HEADLAMP LENS HAS AN INCORRECT AIM PAD NUMBER ON THE LENS. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."

title: Blue Bird Body Company: STRUCTURE:BODY:GRAB BAR:STRAP MOUNTING ASSIST (2,557 affected)
summary: THE FLOOR LINE HANDRAIL BRACKET CAN EXPAND DURING USE AND CREATE AN OPENING WHICH COULD ENTRAP COAT STRINGS, ETC. AND OTHER ARTICLES OF CLOTHING.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC:INDICATOR:LEVER (1,413 affected)
summary: THE AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION WILL NOT SHIFT INTO LOW GEAR DUE TO A MISALIGNMENT IN THE PRNDL INDICATOR.

title: Ford Motor Company: STRUCTURE:HOOD ASSEMBLY:LATCHES (73,837 affected)
summary: THE SECONDARY HOOD LATCH MAY NOT ENGAGE WHEN THE HOOD IS CLOSED.

title: General Motors, LLC: LIGHTING:LAMP OR SOCKET:SIDE MARKER LIGHTS (83,247 affected)
summary: INCORRECT CLEAR FRONT SIDE MARKER BULBS WERE INSTALLED RATHER THAN AMBER BULBS. THIS DOES NOT CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."

title: Allison Transmission, Inc.: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC (665 affected)
summary: THE TRANSMISSION REVERSE SWITCHES CAN CAUSE THE BACKUP LIGHTS TO BE INOPERATIVE. THIS DOES NOT CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."

title: HOLIDAY RAMBLER CORP.: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL (251 affected)
summary: THE FEDERAL CERTIFICATION LABEL INCORRECTLY STATES THE GROSS AXLE WEIGHT RATING (GAWR) CAUSING THE LOAD RATINGS FOR THE TIRES AND TIRE PRESSURES TO BE WRONG. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO.120.

title: EDO CANADA LTD.: FUEL:COMPRESSED NATURAL GAS (CNG) FOR NATURAL GAS (3,539 affected)
summary: THE WATER SEAL O-RING USED IN THE VALVE END BOSS ASSEMBLY OF THE "LITERIDER" CYLINDER COULD BE IMPROPERLY INSTALLED CAUSING AN INTERFERENCE CONDITION.

title: HME, Inc.: BRAKES:AIR DRYER (89 affected)
summary: AIR SYSTEM BLOCKAGE IN THE AIR DRYER OCCURS DEGRADING THE MOISTURE REMOVING CAPABILITIES OF THE DRYER WHEN THE VEHICLE IS OPERATED IN A COLD ENVIRONMENT AND MOISTURE ACCUMULATES AND FREEZES IN THE AIR DRYER OR IN THE LINE BETWEEN THE DRYER AND THE AIR SYSTEM RESERVOIR. THE AIR DRYER CAN BECOME OVERPRESSURIZED CAUSING THE AIR DRYER CARTRIDGE TO SEPARATE FROM THE MOUNTING BASE.

title: AUTOFLUG S.A.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE SEAT AND SHOULDER BELTS AN (300 affected)
summary: AS PART OF AN ONGOING RECALL CAMPAIGN (93E-040), SOFA SAFETY BELT BUCKLE ASSEMBLIES WERE BEING REPLACED.  SOME OF THE CORRECTIVE SAFETY BELT ASSEMBLIES WERE SENT OUT TO DEALERS WHICH WERE OF THE WRONG DESIGN.

title: Land Rover: ENGINE:PULLEY:CRANKSHAFT (3,147 affected)
summary: THE IDLER PULLEY, PART OF THE ENGINE FRONT END SERPENTINE BELT SYSTEM, CAN FAIL RESULTING IN SERPENTINE BELT DAMAGE OR DISENGAGEMENT.

title: Land Rover: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK (15,378 affected)
summary: THE BOTTOM OF THE FUEL TANK CAN CORRODE OVER TIME ALLOWING FUEL TO LEAK.

title: BUELL-out of business: EQUIPMENT:MOTORCYCLE FAIRING (970 affected)
summary: THE FAIRING MOUNT ASSEMBLY BRACKET CAN CRACK AND DETACH FROM THE FRAME.

title: TRANSIT BUS INTERNATIONAL: FUEL:CNG: PRESSURE RELIEF VALVE/DEVICE (94 affected)
summary: UPON EXPOSURE TO IMPURITIES IN THE NATURAL GAS FUEL IN COLD WEATHER, AN INTERNAL O-RING ON THESE DEVICES CAN BLISTER DURING DECOMPRESSION AFTER "FAST-FILL" REFUELING RESULTING IN SEAL LEAKAGE.

title: HOLIDAY RAMBLER CORP.: SUSPENSION (783 affected)
summary: THE STORAGE COMPARTMENT AT THE REAR OF THE UNIT DOES NOT HAVE A SPECIFIED STORAGE WEIGHT LIMITATION AND CAN THEREFORE BE LOADED BEYOND THE MANUFACTURER'S INTENTIONS. ALSO SOME UNITS WERE DESIGNED WITH A FRESH WATER TANK LOCATED AT THE REAR OF THE UNIT. AS A RESULT, THESE TRAILERS EXHIBIT REDUCED STABILITY WHILE BEING TOWED.

title: Rolls-Royce Motor Cars, Ltd.: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC (1,202 affected)
summary: AN INCORRECTLY POSITIONED WIRE WITHIN THE ELECTRICALLY OPERATED GEARBOX ACTUATOR CAN CHAFE AGAINST THE COVER CAUSING THE TRANSMISSION SELECTOR FUSE TO BLOW.

title: Rolls-Royce Motor Cars, Ltd.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACKS AND ANCHORS (107 affected)
summary: BOTH FRONT SEAT BELT LOWER ANCHORAGE RAILS HAVE A MANUFACTURING WEAKNESS WHICH COULD FRACTURE IN A VEHICLE IMPACT.

title: AM GENERAL LLC: FUEL:FUEL TANK ASSEMBLY:TANK (463 affected)
summary: UNDER HIGH AMBIENT TEMPERATURES (GREATER THAN 95 DEGREES FAHRENHEIT) AND THE FUEL TANK LEVEL BETWEEN 1/4 AND 1/2 FULL, THE FUEL TANK INTERNAL PRESSURE CAN INCREASE CAUSING THE TANK TO EXPAND. TANK EXPANSION CAUSES AN INTERFERENCE BETWEEN THE FUEL TANK PROTECTIVE SHIELD AND THE PROPELLER SHAFT RESULTING A HOLE IN THE FUEL TANK AT THE POINT OF SHIELD-TO-SHAFT CONTACT.

title: Utilimaster Corporation: UTILIMASTER/EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL (143 affected)
summary: THE TIRES/TIRE PRESSURES AND WHEELS LISTED ON THE LABEL ARE INCORRECT. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 120, "TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS FOR MOTOR VEHICLES OTHER THAN PASSENGER CARS."

title: ROSTRA PRECISION CONTROLS, INC.: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL (79 affected)
summary: WHEN INSTALLED IN THE VEHICLES, A TIE WRAP IS USED TO GUIDE THE CRUISE CONTROL CABLE IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT.  SOME TIE WRAPS HAVE BEEN INSTALLED WITH A LARGE LOOP OPENING IMPROPERLY GUIDING THE CABLE WHICH COULD PREVENT THE THROTTLE FROM RETURNING TO ITS FULL IDLE POSITION.

title: Hyundai Motor America: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:SHOCK ABSORBER (356 affected)
summary: ONE OR BOTH OF THE REAR SUSPENSION LOWER SPRING SEATS ARE NOT SECURELY ATTACHED TO THE SHOCK ABSORBER AND CAN SLIDE LOWER ONTO THE SHOCK ABSORBER THAN INTENDED. THE REAR SPRING WOULD NO LONGER FUNCTION TO SUPPORT THE VEHICLE BODY AT ITS NORMAL HEIGHT.

title: SOLECTRIA CORPORATION: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (138 affected)
summary: FMVSS NO. 124, "ACCELERATOR CONTROL SYSTEMS" REQUIRES TWO ENERGY SOURCES ON THE ACCELERATOR CONTROL CAPABLE OF RETURNING THE MOTOR CONTROLLER TO THE "IDLE" POSITION. ALTHOUGH THESE VEHICLES ARE EQUIPPED WITH TWO SOURCES OF ENERGY (SPRINGS) ON THE ACCELERATOR CONTROL SYSTEM, ONE SPRING (LOCATED ON THE ACCELERATOR PEDAL) IS NOT CAPABLE OF RETURNING THE ACCELERATOR POTENTIOMETER TO THE "IDLE" POSITION. THIS DOES NOT CONFORM TO THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS NO. 124.

title: Ford Motor Company: STRUCTURE:HATCHBACK HYDRAULIC CYLINDER:TRUNK CYLIN (364,784 affected)
summary: THE HYDRAULIC LIFT CYLINDERS ARE ATTACHED TO BRACKETS THAT ARE WELDED TO THE LIFTGATE. THE BRACKET WELDS CAN FRACTURE.
